banner.title: Data for severity {levels} will be deleted in {time}
banner.undoFailed: Could not cancel the deletion. Try again.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.sub: {org} · which severities the system keeps in detail
retention.info: Un-ticking a severity stops collecting it at once. Its stored rows are deleted only after {days} days; ticking it again inside that time cancels the deletion. Falcon totals on the Overview never change: they come from Falcon's own counts.
retention.sliced: This organization has {total} findings in Falcon. The system keeps detail for {held} of them; the rest is kept as totals only. A tick means "may be stored" and does not change the Falcon totals.

grace.title: Un-ticking does not delete at once
grace.body: Stored data of an un-ticked severity is deleted after {days} days. Tick it again within {days} days and nothing is lost. After that it has to be read again from Falcon, which can take a while.

confirm.title: Stop keeping detail for {levels}?
confirm.body: Collecting stops now. Stored rows of {levels} are deleted in {days} days ({date}). Falcon totals on the Overview do not change. You can undo this until then.

retention.readOnly: You can view these settings but only an administrator of the organization can change them.

error.invalid_severity: One of the severities is not valid.
error.network: The server could not be reached. Nothing was saved.
error.generic: Could not save. Nothing was changed.

retention.unavailable: These settings are not available for this organization.
retention.p1Note: Always-keep-P1 is not offered: KEV and exploited findings of an un-ticked severity are deleted with it.
